literal_meaning: শরীর বা নিতম্ব নাড়ানো (shaking the body or buttocks)
figurative_meaning_en: being engaged in work or toiling diligently
similar_in_english: put one's nose to the grindstone
example_sentences_in_bangla: অকম্মা ছেলেটা কখনো গতর নাড়ে না।
কাজ শুরু করার জন্য গতর নাড়তে হবে।
example_sentences_in_english: The lazy boy never shakes a leg for work.
You have to get moving to start the job.
note: This idiom reflects Bengali cultural emphasis on physical labor and aversion to idleness, often used in rural or semi-urban contexts.
